Workflow

How The Pro Workflow Runs

Four steps, in order — all four are live on JUTTFHX today.

  1. 01 Choose Your Device Start from your actual phone so the baseline matches the hardware you play on.
  2. 02 Choose Your Playstyle Rusher, Support or Tactical — the style shapes how the numbers are weighted.
  3. 03 Refine Your Setup Test in training, adjust, and settle on values you can repeat under pressure.
  4. 04 Enter The Pro Experience The Sensitivity Tuner, Performance Optimizer and HUD Vault below — plus your saved PRO Setups in My Account. Live now — jump in ↓

Last updated: July 1, 2026

📌 General Rules

  • Every player must register before the deadline.
  • Entry fee must be paid before confirmation.
  • Team names cannot contain abusive or offensive words.
  • Players must join the room at least 10 minutes before match start.
  • Room ID & Password will be shared 5–10 minutes before the match.
  • Late players are responsible for their own loss.

👥 Squad Battle Royale Rules

  • Mode: Squad
  • Map: Bermuda / Nexterra / Alpine (Organizer's Choice)
  • Teams: 48 (or as announced)
  • No teaming with other squads.
  • No hacks, scripts, injectors, or cheats.
  • Emulator players are allowed.

🎯 Solo Battle Royale Rules

  • One player per registration.
  • Teaming is strictly prohibited.
  • Intentional teaming = immediate disqualification.
  • Survive and score kills to earn points.

⚔️ Clash Squad Rules

  • Default CS settings.
  • No leaving during the match.
  • Disconnects count unless a disqualification.

🥊 1v1 Rules

  • Map: Battle Arena
  • First to the required rounds wins.
  • No outside interference.
  • Both players must save screenshot after win for proof if requested.

🚫 Fair Play Rules

Players will be banned immediately if found using:

  • Hacks
  • Scripts
  • Config files
  • Injectors
  • Third-party apps
  • VPN for unfair advantage (if prohibited by organizer)

Organizer has the right to request proof if cheating is suspected.

📹 Recording Rules

Players should:

  • Record gameplay whenever possible.
  • Keep recordings for at least 24 hours after the tournament.
  • Submit recordings if requested.

Failure to provide proof may result in disqualification if a complaint is upheld.

📸 Result Submission

After every match:

  • Take a screenshot of the result screen.
  • Team leader submits the screenshot within 10 minutes.
  • Missing or edited screenshots will not be accepted.

💰 Prize Rules

  • Prize money is sent after results are verified.
  • Verification may take 5–10 minutes.
  • Incorrect payment details are the player's responsibility.

❌ Disqualification

Players or teams will be disqualified for:

  • Cheating
  • Teaming (Solo)
  • Sharing Room ID/Password
  • Fake payment proof
  • Match fixing
  • Refusing organizer instructions
  • Using an unregistered account (if account registration is required)

⚠️ Refund Policy

Entry fees are non-refundable once registration is confirmed.

  • If the organizer cancels the tournament before it starts, a full refund or rescheduled event will be provided.
  • No refunds for missed matches or late arrivals.

📢 Organizer Rights

The organizer reserves the right to:

  • Change the match schedule if necessary.
  • Disqualify players violating the rules.
  • Cancel or postpone tournaments due to technical issues.
  • Make the final decision in all disputes.

🏆 Sportsmanship

Respect all players and staff.

  • No toxicity.
  • No harassment.
  • No hate speech.
  • Play fairly and enjoy the competition.

The organizer's final decision will be considered binding in all tournament matters.
